messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Restore the outer halves of all four arms, extending each back to the full outer length and rebuilding them to full thickness; remove the 45° upward slopes so every arm has a flat underside and constant thickness to the tip.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response:
```json
{
  "match": true,
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "reason": "The edited part clearly shows the arms extended to full length and rebuilt with significant thickness and vertical sides, removing the original thin, sloped profile."
}
```
